latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the in-video skill.

- Instantly edit and export video clips via cloud-based GPU processing.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automated features: remove pauses, add background music, overlay text titles, and more based on your prompt.
- Anonymous access with free starter token (100 credits, 7 days validity); session management handled automatically.
- Simple command-based workflow—no need for complex software; 1080p MP4 export in 1–2 minutes.
- Clear error handling, API integration, and support for batch/iterative editing.
